About the data

Source: SECOP II – Contratos Electrónicos, Agencia Nacional de Contratación Pública – Colombia Compra Eficiente, published on datos.gov.co under CC BY-SA 4.0. Filter used: sector = "Educación Nacional" and signing date in 2025. Data extracted on ; SECOP II is updated continuously, so later extractions can differ.

Method notes

Procurement methods are grouped from SECOP's "modalidad de contratación" (for example, "Contratación directa" and "Contratación Directa (con ofertas)" are both direct contracting). "Individuals" are contractors identified with a personal ID (cédula, passport). Department and level are those of the contracting entity, as reported by SECOP. Contracts with a value of 0 are counted but do not change the totals. Names of people are not included anywhere in this project.

Limitations

Values are contract values at signing (plus registered changes), not payments. Sector and level classifications come from the source and can contain errors. This is a sample analysis of open data, not an audit.
